_comment: Curated JSON-schema entries for the commands documented in two.avogadro.cc/source/develop/rpc.md (§4.2 of avogadro-mcp-plan.md). The server overlays this on whatever listCommands() reports at runtime, so tools have real parameter types on day one. Every entry is marked "source": "catalogue" so a future app-provided schema (§4.3 of the plan, commandSchema()) wins when present. Keep this in sync with rpc.md by hand until the doc-build check in the plan exists.

version.description: Report the running Avogadro app, avogadrolibs, and Qt versions, and the RPC protocol level.

listCommands.description: List every command Avogadro will answer, built-in and plugin alike.

openFile.description: Read a file from disk and make it the active molecule. The format is inferred from the extension.

fileName.description: Path to the file to open.

loadMolecule.description: Read molecular data from a string in any format Avogadro can read, and make it the active molecule.

content.description: The file contents as a string.

format.description: Any file format Avogadro can read, e.g. "xyz", "cml", "pdb", "sdf".

moleculeInfo.description: Summarize the active molecule: atom/bond counts, formula, mass, charge, and what it has (a unit cell, a basis set, vibrations, ...).

getMolecule.description: Read the active molecule back as text, in any format FileFormatManager can write, without touching disk.

format.description: Any file format Avogadro can write, e.g. "xyz", "cml", "pdb", "sdf".

exportFile.description: Write the active molecule to a file, guessing the format from the extension. Runs on a background thread -- pass wait to be told when the write has actually finished.

saveGraphic.description: Save a bitmap image of the active view at its current on-screen size. ".png" is appended if the name has no extension.

renderImage.description: Render the view at any size, to a file or back inline as PNG bytes. Omit width/height for the native framebuffer resolution, or supply both together.

width.description: Image width in pixels. Must be given together with height, or not at all.

height.description: Image height in pixels. Must be given together with width, or not at all.

transparentBackground.description: Render with a transparent background instead of the scene's background colour.

fileName.description: Path to write the PNG to. If omitted, the image is returned inline as base64 in the reply.

setRenderTypes.description: Choose which scene display types are active, either as a list of names to turn on or a map of name to boolean.

types.description: Display type identifiers to turn on, e.g. ["BallStick", "VanDerWaals"].

listDisplayTypes.description: List the scene display types available for the active view, and whether each is on, applicable, and configurable.

internalPing.description: Check whether the server is responsive. Answers "pong".

kill.description: Shut down Avogadro. Only enabled when started with --testing, which the argument parser currently rejects, so this is unreachable in practice.

createBonds.description: Perceive bonds between all atoms, or within the selection if there is one.

removeBonds.description: Remove bonds from all atoms, or from the selection.

centerAtom.description: Move the molecule so that this atom sits at the origin. Atoms are numbered from zero.

alignAtom.description: Rotate the molecule so this atom lies along an axis.

rotateScene.description: Rotate the camera about the screen x, y, and z axes, through the current focal point.

x.description: Degrees to rotate about the screen x axis.

y.description: Degrees to rotate about the screen y axis.

z.description: Degrees to rotate about the screen z axis.

zoomScene.description: Zoom in or out. Positive values move toward the molecule.

delta.description: Positive to zoom in, negative to zoom out.

translateScene.description: Pan the camera by a distance given in screen pixels.

alignView.description: Align the view to the x, y, and z axes, centered on the molecule and backed off far enough to frame it.

wrapUnitCell.description: Wrap all atoms back into the unit cell.

standardCrystalOrientation.description: Rotate the unit cell into the standard orientation.

fillUnitCell.description: Add the symmetry-equivalent atoms implied by the space group.

fillTranslationalCell.description: Fill the cell including atoms related by translation.

renderVanDerWaals.description: Render the van der Waals surface. Runs in the background; pass wait to know when the surface exists.

resolution.description: Cube spacing in Å. Avogadro picks a value from the molecule's size (0.05-0.5 Å) if omitted.

renderSolventAccessible.description: Render the solvent-accessible surface. Runs in the background; pass wait to know when the surface exists.

renderSolventExcluded.description: Render the solvent-excluded surface. Runs in the background; pass wait to know when the surface exists.

renderMO.description: Render a molecular orbital, for a file that includes a basis set. Runs in the background; pass wait to know when the surface exists.

orbital.description: A number counting from 1 (the lowest orbital), or a name relative to the frontier orbitals: "homo", "lumo", "homo-1", "lumo+2", etc.

resolution.description: Cube spacing in Å. Avogadro picks a value from the molecule's size if omitted.

spin.description: "beta" for the beta orbitals of an open-shell calculation; alpha is used otherwise.

orbital.description: A number counting from 1, or a name like "homo", "lumo", "homo-1".

renderElectronDensity.description: Render the total electron density. Runs in the background; pass wait to know when the surface exists.

renderSpinDensity.description: Render the spin density. Runs in the background; pass wait to know when the surface exists.

renderCube.description: Render a cube that came with the file. Runs in the background; pass wait to know when the surface exists.

index.description: Cube number, counting from one. Defaults to the first cube.

setVibrationalMode.description: Select a vibrational mode, numbered from zero.

setVibrationalAmplitude.description: Set the animation amplitude, on the same 0-99 scale as the dialog slider (which starts at 20).

startVibrationAnimation.description: Start animating the selected vibrational mode.

generateDisplacedCoordinates.description: Append coordinate sets displaced along one or more vibrational modes.

modes.description: Mode number(s), zero-based. A single "mode" is also accepted.

structures.description: How many displaced geometries to generate.
